correctness.rationale: For A=I+D with D^2=0 and N=r ell^T nonzero nilpotent, N A^k N=k gamma N. For each p>0 and 0<q<1 the strictly decreasing convergent scalar series has a unique root lambda>q. The explicit positive homogeneous V_p(x)=sum_{k>=0}q^k |ell^T A^k x|^p/lambda^(k+1) is finite and uniformly equivalent to ||x||^p because ell^T and ell^T D are independent rows. Its one-step expectation is lambda V_p exactly, proving two-sided all-time moment rates. Geometric dropout counts give unique critical thresholds; adjacent successes force a.s. absorption. The canonical p=1 and p=2 formulas and critical SPD matrix were algebraically verified, and 1165 standalone checks passed. Infinite claims rest on the analytical proof, not finite tests.

value.rationale: The exact p-dependent packet-erasure phase diagram is a motivated risk-sensitive control classification, not a numerical coincidence. A continuous family of sharp moment boundaries and constructive positive homogeneous eigen-energies identify an all-order stability gap in a controllable two-step deadbeat plant. In particular, 1/3<q<1/2 yields almost-sure finite-time extinction and exponentially decaying expected norm with exponentially exploding expected squared norm. This has concrete meaning for stochastic control reliability and distinguishes moment criteria that aggregate rare, long erasure runs.
